# The Pitt: All spawn locations for Fanatic battle plan locked safes

With credit to Vicyorus.

This guide is for The Foundry, a location that you visit during the Union Dues mission.

This guide will cover all sections of the Foundry and all spawn locations of the Fanatic battle plan locked safes.

The Foundry itself is split into 7 areas.

- Tunnel
- Chem Lab
- Fire Pit
- Canal
- Twin Cauldrons
- The Belts
- Warehouse

All are clearly marked with signage. This signage might appear on walls or on the floor.

#### **Tunnel**

This is where you spawn in at, after the team leader has interacted with the wooden door outside.

#### **Chem Lab**

This area can be identified by all the extra machinary and consoles. It is also the first section you enter, after the tunnel.

#### **Fire Pit**

This area can be identified by the six large pipes, pumping hot melted steel into the channel in the middle of the room.

#### **Canal**

This area can be identified by the channel of hot melted steel running down the middle of the room.

#### **Twin Cauldrons**

This area can be identified by the two large vats filled with green goo.

#### **The Belts**

This area can be identified by the conveyor belts running through the middle of the room.

#### **Warehouse**

This area can be identified by all the shipping containers.

Map of the Foundry sections can be found __here.__

Location guide for Union supply crates can be found here.

Location guide for Steel Ingots can be found here.

### **__Objective: Fanatic battle plan locked safes__**

__Objective: Fanatic battle plan locked safes__

Hex will send you to the Foundry to recover Fanatic plans from locked safes during part 2 of the mission.

There are 10 possible spawn locations, with only three spawning per expedition.

### **Spawn locations for the locked safes:**

#### **Tunnel**

1 possible spawn location

Upstairs in the blue metal office building, on the North end of the tunnel, just past the upside down train carriage.

#### **Chem Lab**

1 possible spawn location

Downstairs, as you enter the Chem Lab via the tunnel, past the red forklift, in the control room.

#### **Fire Pit**

1 possible spawn location

Upstairs, next to the lockers, in the blue metal office building, on the East end of the room.

#### **Twin Cauldrons**

2 possible spawn location

In the blue metal office building, directly above the twin cauldrons (green goo filled vats)

Inside the blue metal office building, on the ground floor, with the white machine against the back wall.

#### **The Belts**

1 possible spawn location

Upstairs in the blue metal building on the West side of the room

#### **Canal**

1 possible spawn location

On the West side of the room, at the end of the channel of hot melted steel, near the weapons workbench and incinerator, on top of the pipe leading to the other room.

#### **Warehouse**

3 possible spawn location

Upstairs, in the kitchen, in the far corner, near the stoves.

Inside the solo green shipping container

Upstairs, in the blue metal office building, on the East side of the room. Look for the conveyor belts on the floor so you know that you are in the right area.
